content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi is a medical institute in New Delhi. The notice was issued on 27 October 2026 and signed by Dr. Yatan Pal Singh Balhara, Professor, Psychiatry & NDDTC, AIIMS, New Delhi-110029. The post is part of a project at AIIMS that the ICMR funds.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS New Delhi Project Technical Support III Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must be 18 to 35 years old. The notice says age relaxation applies as per rules. Candidates need one of the following: A graduate degree in Statistics, or a joint degree in Mathematics and Statistics, with three years of experience, OR A post-graduate degree in Statistics, or a joint degree in Mathematics and Statistics. The three years of experience are required only for graduates. Candidates who meet the post-graduate option do not need any experience. For the full eligibility of the post, check the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. Who funds the Project Technical Support III post at AIIMS New Delhi?
faq.answer: The post is temporary and comes under a project at AIIMS New Delhi that the ICMR funds.

faq.question: Q2. Can a graduate with no experience apply?
faq.answer: No. A graduate in Statistics, or in Mathematics and Statistics jointly, needs three years of experience. Only a post-graduate degree in these subjects qualifies without experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is a joint degree in Mathematics and Statistics accepted?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice accepts a joint degree in Mathematics and Statistics at both graduate and post-graduate level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit, and is there any relaxation?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18-35 years. Age relaxation applies as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What time does the application close on 10 November 2026?
faq.answer: The form must be submitted by 5 PM on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. When will the interview take place?
faq.answer: AIIMS will announce the interview date later.

faq.question: Q7. Who signed the notice?
faq.answer: Dr. Yatan Pal Singh Balhara, Professor, Psychiatry & NDDTC, AIIMS, New Delhi-110029, signed the notice dated 27 October 2026.
